WebRTC/SIP RFC 5764 / RFC 9146 DTLS-SRTP CID Mobility Anti-Hijack & MKI Seamless Rekey Guard
企业 WebRTC/SIP DTLS-SRTP (RFC 5764/9146) CID [2,8] 漫游防劫持、反 SRTP_NULL 空加密降级与 MKI [300,3600]s 双钥无缝轮换门禁（🎉 880 探针 & 690 现场探针里程碑）
1. DTLS CID Mobility & Anti-SRTP_NULL Gate (P861)
• 痛点：Wi-Fi 切 5G 触发 3s ICE 断音，或盲目开启 Symmetric RTP 被单包伪造源 IP 劫持
• 降级风险：客户端诱导协商 SRTP_NULL_HMAC_SHA1_80 空加密套件导致全通话明文泄露
❌ Attack: use_srtp=SRTP_NULL | Spoofed UDP IP rebind without AEAD auth
✅ P861 Gate: Ban SRTP_NULL + AEAD-Verified CID Rebind + [2, 8] Spare CIDs
Action: reject_null_srtp_cipher_and_require_aead_verified_cid_rebind
确定性收敛指标（P861）：
✔ clampedNullCipherOrUnauthenticatedCidRebinds = 0（100% 阻断空加密与伪造重绑）
✔ clampedDtlsCidSparePoolSize ∈ [2, 8]（防跨网追踪备用 CID 池大小）
2. SRTP MKI Seamless Rotation & Overlap Gate (P862)
• 痛点：长通话在线切换 MKI 主密钥时立即销毁旧密钥，导致在途乱序尾包验签失败爆音
• 双钥重叠：将 MKI 轮换周期锁在 [300, 3600]s 并维护 (MKI_old, MKI_new) 双上下文窗口
❌ Desync: 30s rapid rekey storm | Single-key cut drops 9 late MKI_old frames
✅ P862 Gate: Dual-MKI Grace Overlap Window + [300, 3600]s Rekey Interval
Action: enforce_dual_mki_overlap_window_and_clamp_rekey_interval
确定性收敛指标（P862）：
✔ clampedMkiRekeyDesyncDroppedFrames = 0（换钥期间 0 乱序音频帧被丢弃）
✔ clampedSrtpMkiKeyRotationIntervalSeconds ∈ [300, 3600] s（合规主密钥轮换周期）
